","DalamudApiLevel":15,"Description":"The Deep Ducking public host provides the introduction, community links and authenticated loading of separately supplied DDuck modules. /deepducking and /dduck open the introduction when no module is loaded.

Full module required for all commands below except opening the host window.

Commands (use /deepducking; /dduck is an alias):
/deepducking [toggle main window]
/dduck [alias for /deepducking; accepts all commands below]
/deepducking mini [toggle Mini]
/deepducking settings [open Settings]
/deepducking config [open Settings]
/deepducking debug [reveal and open Advanced for this plugin load]
/deepducking help [open command help]
/deepducking start [floor] [start or continue selected save; optional fresh-run floor]
/deepducking party-start [floor] [alias for start]
/deepducking party [select fixed-party POTD while idle]
/deepducking adopt [bind eligible already-entered party dungeon]
/deepducking hold [pause local output; retain run for Resume]
/deepducking resume [resume retained local run after readiness checks]
/deepducking nextstop [exit after next boss]
/deepducking ns [exit after next boss]
/deepducking stop [FULL STOP; persist local lock across reloads; stay in duty]
/deepducking reset-stop [clear eligible FULL STOP after cleanup; do not start]
/deepducking status [print local status]
/deepducking inspect [record read-only client and native observations]
/deepducking saves [open Saves]
/deepducking saves info <dungeon> [inspect native saves]
/deepducking saves delete <dungeon> <1|2> [delete selected save after native checks; no extra confirmation]
/deepducking saves dof <dungeon> <1|2> <on|off> [set future-failure deletion preference; no deletion now]
/deepducking saves cancel [cancel pending save or Start preparation; completed actions remain]

Dungeon arguments: potd, hoh, eo, pt. [floor] is optional; <...> is required. Choose one value for 1|2 or on|off; omit brackets when typing. Start can replace stopped state; Resume can release an eligible retained in-dungeon run. nextstop and ns retain the save and keep Mini open until return is observed; repeat to confirm the same request. Use the existing boss-break button to cancel.

If DailyDuty is installed, /dd is unavailable for Deep Ducking; use /deepducking. An alias owned by another plugin is preserved.

    * Some more changes coming soon but emergency maintenance started RIP

    * Reawakened Fangs Feature now also applies to Steel Maw.
    
    1.5.0.79:

    * Meisui/Tenri priority fixed and DWaD to Meisui added.
    * Monk's Draconic Leap feature now properly syncs below level 50 when you don't have a form.
    * Raise Hard Target Lockout Feature added.
    
    1.5.0.72:
    * Double Down features now account for its new cost.
    * New option for Royal Authority to Atonement where it will only activate if you are about to overwrite Sword Oath in your combo.
    * Empyreal Arrow will no longer turn into Pitch Perfect under any circumstances.
    
    1.5.0.71:
    * Updated for 7.1 compatibility.

    * Added an 'Only When Full' option to Sidewinder to Pitch Perfect.

    1.5.0.70:
    * Added Comet Overwrite Prevention feature. Or did I?
    * Removed Holy overcap features (it made no sense when you gain, not lose, DPS by letting it overcap).
    
    1.5.0.69 (Nice):
    * Sacrificium Feature added.
    * Despair to Flare Star added.
    * Dragon Kick to Forbidden Chakra added.
    
    1.5.0.67:
    * Blizzard 3 & 2 to Flare Star feature added.
    
    1.5.0.61:
    * Lucid Dreaming Reminders now have a configurable MP threshold, as well as a configurable cooldown remaining offset where they stop replacing the cooldown.
    
    1.5.0.60:
    * Combos to Saber Dance during Devilment feature added.
    * Some other stuff added to Dancer, too. Maybe.
    * Phlegma to Psyche added.
    
    1.5.0.59:
    * Isle Sprint feature added.
    
    1.5.0.53:
    * Reaving Steel added from regular XIVComboExpanded. Maybe something else, too? Tis a secret.
    * Hooking Hooksets and Chummy Cast added.
    
    1.5.0.51:
    * Chaotic Glide added.
    
    1.5.0.49:
    * Standard Step into Technical Step added.
    
    1.5.0.41:
    * Viper features added. {"Author":"Legends of the Game","Name":"Tales of Milestones","InternalName":"TimeMemoriaV3","AssemblyVersion":"3.16.0.15","Description":"Quest progression and pacing — a reflective notebook for your story journey, not a scoreboard.","ApplicableVersion":"any","RepoUrl":"https://github.com/LegendsOfTheGame/TimeMemoriaV3","Tags":["quest","quests","progression","pacing"],"CategoryTags":["utility"],"DalamudApiLevel":15,"LoadRequiredState":0,"LoadSync":false,"CanUnloadAsync":false,"LoadPriority":0,"Punchline":"Remember every step, Warriors of Light.","AcceptsFeedback":true,"IsHide":false,"IsTestingExclusive":false,"DownloadLinkInstall":"https://github.com/LegendsOfTheGame/TimeMemoriaV3/releases/latest/download/latest.zip","DownloadLinkUpdate":"https://github.com/LegendsOfTheGame/TimeMemoriaV3/releases/latest/download/latest.zip","DownloadLinkTesting":"https://github.com/LegendsOfTheGame/TimeMemoriaV3/releases/latest/download/latest.zip","IconUrl":"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LegendsOfTheGame/TimeMemoriaV3/main/assets/icon.png","DownloadCount":0,"Changelog":"Tales of Milestones:
- Hunting Log window (`/hunt`). A new optional feature. Type `/hunt`, or switch it on in Settings. The window shows every Hunting Log monster that you still need, for all your unlocked classes and your Grand Company at the same time. You do not have to change class to see a class's log. Each row shows the class, the task, the monster, your kills and where to find it. Finished monsters, finished ranks and locked classes are not shown.
- Map flags for Hunting Log monsters. Click Flag on a row to open the map at that monster. If the monster is also in your current zone, the row shows that location. The locations come from the Hunty plugin by Infiziert90 (MIT License).
- Current class only and Current zone only. Two check boxes in the Hunting Log window. With Current zone only, the window shows only the monsters in the zone where you are, for all classes. The window updates when you change class or zone.
- Change class from the Hunting Log. In the summary line at the top of the window, click a class name to equip a gear set for that class. If you have more than one gear set for the class, a list opens and you select one. The game's own Gear Set function does the change, the same as a click in the Gear Set window. Nothing is sent to chat.
- Hunting Log in the export. The export has a new `huntLog` block with each class's rank and kill counts. The Adventurer's Ledger reads it.
- Leve markers. In the quest list, a leve whose items are in your bags now shows "[R]" in place of a check mark. The check mark means "complete" in the News panel. Hold the pointer on a leve row to see what "> " and "[R]" mean.
- Fix: allied societies in the mini window. The society list shows only societies that are capped and wait for a main quest. Societies at their last rank are not listed.
Adventurer's Ledger (Pandora Lunar):
- Hunting Log. Jobs has a Hunting Log frame. It shows each class's rank, its tasks complete, and the monsters it still needs, with the place. Import a Tales of Milestones export to fill it in.
- Gear guide. Jobs has a Gear guide frame. Select one job and level. It shows the highest item level for each slot from the sources that you tick, with options for your export, crafting, NPC vendors and the market board.
- Mentor Roulette readiness. The Mentor tab has a Roulette frame, also listed under Jobs and Duties. It shows the Battle Mentor requirements: the level 100 role quests, a combat job at level 100, and each duty in the game's Mentor Roulette pool cleared once. Missing duties are listed by expansion and type. Item level 755 is a manual check, because the export does not have it.
- Import preview: Challenge Log. When an export opens new Challenge Log entries, the import preview shows them, for example "Challenge Log entries open: 40 → 41 (new: Soul Survivor I)".
- Allied societies. When every society in a group is at its last rank and the Intersocietal Quests are done, the group shows only the names, ranks and the quest check box.
- Fix: Ocean Fishing clock. The bar shows the time as "29:58" again, not "00:29:58".
- Fix: new characters. A new character no longer stops the Quest items frame after you enter a crafter or gatherer level. "Mark items HQ" is on by default again.
- Fix: backup import. A backup with no characters no longer leaves the page empty until a reload.
- Fix: Challenge Log. The Challenge Log list now comes from the game's data, so it matches the game after a patch.
- Fix: smaller items. The Collections filter (All, Owned, Missing) keeps its selection when you change area. Collapsed sections stay collapsed. Ended events leave the events feed. The time zone and hunt switches work with Space and Enter.
- Faster pages. The Ledger draws only the area and frame on screen.","SourceRepo":"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LegendsOfTheGame/TimeMemoriaV3/main/repo.json"}

{"Author":"Legends of the Game","Name":"Tales of Milestones","InternalName":"TimeMemoriaV3","AssemblyVersion":"3.16.0.15","Description":"Quest progression and pacing — a reflective notebook for your story journey, not a scoreboard.","ApplicableVersion":"any","RepoUrl":"https://github.com/LegendsOfTheGame/TimeMemoriaV3","Tags":["quest","quests","progression","pacing"],"CategoryTags":["utility"],"DalamudApiLevel":15,"LoadRequiredState":0,"LoadSync":false,"CanUnloadAsync":false,"LoadPriority":0,"Punchline":"Remember every step, Warriors of Light.","AcceptsFeedback":true,"IsHide":false,"IsTestingExclusive":false,"DownloadLinkInstall":"https://github.com/LegendsOfTheGame/TimeMemoriaV3/releases/latest/download/latest.zip","DownloadLinkUpdate":"https://github.com/LegendsOfTheGame/TimeMemoriaV3/releases/latest/download/latest.zip","DownloadLinkTesting":"https://github.com/LegendsOfTheGame/TimeMemoriaV3/releases/latest/download/latest.zip","IconUrl":"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LegendsOfTheGame/TimeMemoriaV3/main/assets/icon.png","DownloadCount":0,"Changelog":"Tales of Milestones:
- Hunting Log window (`/hunt`). A new optional feature. Type `/hunt`, or switch it on in Settings. The window shows every Hunting Log monster that you still need, for all your unlocked classes and your Grand Company at the same time. You do not have to change class to see a class's log. Each row shows the class, the task, the monster, your kills and where to find it. Finished monsters, finished ranks and locked classes are not shown.
- Map flags for Hunting Log monsters. Click Flag on a row to open the map at that monster. If the monster is also in your current zone, the row shows that location. The locations come from the Hunty plugin by Infiziert90 (MIT License).
- Current class only and Current zone only. Two check boxes in the Hunting Log window. With Current zone only, the window shows only the monsters in the zone where you are, for all classes. The window updates when you change class or zone.
- Change class from the Hunting Log. In the summary line at the top of the window, click a class name to equip a gear set for that class. If you have more than one gear set for the class, a list opens and you select one. The game's own Gear Set function does the change, the same as a click in the Gear Set window. Nothing is sent to chat.
- Hunting Log in the export. The export has a new `huntLog` block with each class's rank and kill counts. The Adventurer's Ledger reads it.
- Leve markers. In the quest list, a leve whose items are in your bags now shows "[R]" in place of a check mark. The check mark means "complete" in the News panel. Hold the pointer on a leve row to see what "> " and "[R]" mean.
- Fix: allied societies in the mini window. The society list shows only societies that are capped and wait for a main quest. Societies at their last rank are not listed.
Adventurer's Ledger (Pandora Lunar):
- Hunting Log. Jobs has a Hunting Log frame. It shows each class's rank, its tasks complete, and the monsters it still needs, with the place. Import a Tales of Milestones export to fill it in.
- Gear guide. Jobs has a Gear guide frame. Select one job and level. It shows the highest item level for each slot from the sources that you tick, with options for your export, crafting, NPC vendors and the market board.
- Mentor Roulette readiness. The Mentor tab has a Roulette frame, also listed under Jobs and Duties. It shows the Battle Mentor requirements: the level 100 role quests, a combat job at level 100, and each duty in the game's Mentor Roulette pool cleared once. Missing duties are listed by expansion and type. Item level 755 is a manual check, because the export does not have it.
- Import preview: Challenge Log. When an export opens new Challenge Log entries, the import preview shows them, for example "Challenge Log entries open: 40 → 41 (new: Soul Survivor I)".
- Allied societies. When every society in a group is at its last rank and the Intersocietal Quests are done, the group shows only the names, ranks and the quest check box.
- Fix: Ocean Fishing clock. The bar shows the time as "29:58" again, not "00:29:58".
- Fix: new characters. A new character no longer stops the Quest items frame after you enter a crafter or gatherer level. "Mark items HQ" is on by default again.
- Fix: backup import. A backup with no characters no longer leaves the page empty until a reload.
- Fix: Challenge Log. The Challenge Log list now comes from the game's data, so it matches the game after a patch.
- Fix: smaller items. The Collections filter (All, Owned, Missing) keeps its selection when you change area. Collapsed sections stay collapsed. Ended events leave the events feed. The time zone and hunt switches work with Space and Enter.
- Faster pages. The Ledger draws only the area and frame on screen.","_SourceId":"legendsofthegame-timememoriav3","_SourceName":"LegendsOfTheGame / TimeMemoriaV3","_SourceUrl":"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LegendsOfTheGame/TimeMemoriaV3/main/repo.json","_Category":"automation"}

{"Author":"The Combat Reborn Team","Name":"Rotation Solver Reborn","InternalName":"RotationSolver","Description":"Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

This means almost all the information available in one frame in combat, including the status of all players in the party, the status of any hostile targets, skill cooldowns, the MP and HP of characters, the location of characters, casting status of the hostile target, combo, combat duration, player level, etc.

{"Author":"dajoey","Name":"Gluttony Combo","ApplicableVersion":"any","AssemblyVersion":"1.0.4.340","CategoryTags":null,"Changelog":"v1.0.4.341 (2026-11-17) [testing]
- **The Fight Brain countdown strip no longer keeps past forecasts on screen.** A clock mix-up inside the forecast tick compared the entries' Unix timestamps against the machine's uptime clock, so the rule that drops a forecast three seconds after its moment passed could never fire: old entries piled up, filled the forecast list, and the strip showed a fixed set of entries whose countdowns grew ever more negative for the rest of the session. The tick now prunes on the same clock the entries carry, and the strip itself shows only entries still ahead (with one second of grace), so a fight's leftovers disappear instead of counting up in the negative.
- **The Fight Brain countdown strip only draws during combat now.** Outside a fight it draws nothing, even while the forecast source is still answering, so the strip no longer sits on the screen between fights.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.340 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The settings window has been rebuilt in the same custom window style as the other plugins and polished for the real in-game font and scale, with every preset, option and saved setting unchanged.
- The window uses a two-level layout: Combos, Automation and System tabs, a row of destinations for the open tab, a page header and a status footer that stays in view. Long pages fade out above the footer instead of being cut off.
- Preset cards have even padding, a larger title and toggles that sit inside the card, and a whole toggle row, label included, can be clicked. Search keeps one width on every page, shows a dimmed hint, has a clear button and reports a result count.
- The problem report button sits in the footer so it is reachable on every page and window size, and the status pill shows a running rotation in green and a blocked one in amber.
- This build also picks up the restyled shared What's new window and Report a problem popup.

v1.0.4.339 (2026-11-14) [testing]
- The plugin windows have been rebuilt on the shared LalaUiKit: one consistent layout with themed section headers, unified spacing and colour accents. All settings and behaviour are unchanged, and existing configuration loads as-is.

v1.0.4.338 (2026-11-10) [testing]
- Rebuilt against the Dalamud 15.0.4.0 payload for game patch 7.58. No functional changes.

v1.0.4.337 (2026-11-09) [testing]
- **The AI decision layer is gone.** The Fight Brain's question side - the raidwide mitigation ask, the pre-pull plan reader (party finder text and the `/gluttony plan` note command), and the party-callout reader - has been removed from the plugin, together with its relay address setting and the two "Plan Reader"/"Callout Reader" switches. GluttonyCombo no longer asks any decision model anything, sends no snapshot anywhere, and keeps no relay URL: the only network path it still uses is the movement tap's `/move/ingest` upload, which records the movement profiles and never carried a decision.
- What stays is pure code and unchanged: the rotation and every combo, the Fight Brain forecast reads and `FB|forecast` lines, the countdown strip, the shadow cast-gate lines, the party-data shadow rules (`FB|party-mit`, `FB|pos-zone`), and the movement recorder and shadow move planner. The move planner's `MP|` decision lines keep their exact format and now always carry the code pick only.
- The shadow move planner no longer has its ask-side toggle; `/gluttony movelog` now switches the recorder and the planner together, and its status line reads two switches instead of three.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.336 (2026-11-09) [testing]
- **Saving a custom action to a hotbar while in PvP now writes the PvP layout.** The custom-action editor's hotbar save told the game the write was a normal-slot write regardless of the current content, so a save made while in PvP updated the regular hotbar set instead of the PvP one; the call now passes the content check (upstream's fix), so the PvP variant of the slot is the one written.
- **The action-replacing hook answers in the game's own yes/no shape.** The IsActionIdReplaceable detour and its delegate declared an unsigned 64-bit return where the game's callback uses a boolean, so the replace decision relied on 0/1 marshalling to land correctly; both signatures now match the native BOOL return (upstream's fix), and the early-return values read true/false instead of 1/0. No behavior change is intended - this removes a latent hook-contract mismatch.

{"Author":"dajoey","Name":"LazyCrafter","ApplicableVersion":"any","AssemblyVersion":"0.1.7.13","CategoryTags":["utility"],"Changelog":"v0.1.7.15 (2026-11-21) [testing]
- Crafts that were waiting on a material WahTools handed back no longer run into a wall of failed-craft lines in the same pass. They are pulled out of the wave's craft queue the moment the hand-back happens, their rows on the Run tab show them waiting for the next pass, and the re-plan remakes them on the material's new route.
- Crafts no longer start while WahTools Hunter is still driving the character after a hunt. The hand-off to Artisan now waits for WahTools to go idle, the same gate the other WahTools hand-offs use, and logs one line when it does.
- The blocked report now lists the fish and monster-drop materials WahTools was handed, so the Run tab and /lcraft status show what a blocked run is waiting on.
- WahTools' Hunter is now offered an item's monsters in a smarter order: the highest-level monster the character can already beat first, then monsters with no known level, then monsters above the character's combat level from the lowest up. The level data comes from the installed WahTools itself; when it cannot be read, a warning is logged once per session and the previous order is kept.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.

v0.1.7.14 (2026-11-21) [testing]
- **Monster-drop materials can be hunted with WahTools.** When WahTools is loaded, a material that a known monster drops is handed to WahTools' Hunter instead of going straight to the market-board list. Hunter counts kills, not drops, so the run hunts in batches, recounts the bags between batches, and stops as soon as enough have landed. It gives up after two batches in a row that drop nothing (or eight in total), and the rest goes back on the market-board or manual list on the next pass. Gil-vendor items, and currency-shop items the character can already pay for, are still bought, never hunted.
- **Fish materials can be caught with WahTools.** When WahTools is loaded, a fish that no gathering node yields goes to WahTools' Feesh instead of GatherBuddyReborn. A fish WahTools will not take, such as an ocean fish, goes back to GatherBuddyReborn on the next pass. The caught fish stay protected from WahTools' own discard and desynth rules until the run ends, including while a blocked run waits for Resume.
- Both run after GatherBuddyReborn and before Artisan, and crafts that need them wait for them. Each has its own setting under Dispatch behavior, both on by default; with WahTools absent or both settings off, routing is exactly as before. Stop ends a WahTools fish or hunt in progress.
- The Integrations list shows whether WahTools is loaded.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.

v0.1.7.13 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The window was polished for the real in-game font and scale: text no longer clips or sits against card borders.
- The catalog table keeps its sortable, resizable and reorderable columns and its right-click menu for showing and hiding columns; columns that do not fit start hidden.
- Numeric column headers line up with the figures beneath them in the catalog, cart, ledger and run tables, and no header is cut mid-word at larger UI scales.
- Recipe details are organised into summary, ingredient and market cards, with source and unit price under each ingredient and the fulfil buttons beside them.
- The Settings and Run pages no longer repeat the same warning or state word, and short windows get a compact page header that leaves more room for the table.

v0.1.7.12 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The plugin window now uses a responsive card-based shell for catalog, cart, run and settings, with integrated area navigation, destination search, live page counts, a close button in the header and persistent dispatch and footer actions. Catalog logic, cart editing, dispatch, integrations and saved configuration are unchanged.

v0.1.7.11 (2026-11-14) [testing]

v0.1.7.14 (2026-11-21) [testing]
- **Monster-drop materials can be hunted with WahTools.** When WahTools is loaded, a material that a known monster drops is handed to WahTools' Hunter instead of going straight to the market-board list. Hunter counts kills, not drops, so the run hunts in batches, recounts the bags between batches, and stops as soon as enough have landed. It gives up after two batches in a row that drop nothing (or eight in total), and the rest goes back on the market-board or manual list on the next pass. Gil-vendor items, and currency-shop items the character can already pay for, are still bought, never hunted.
- **Fish materials can be caught with WahTools.** When WahTools is loaded, a fish that no gathering node yields goes to WahTools' Feesh instead of GatherBuddyReborn. A fish WahTools will not take, such as an ocean fish, goes back to GatherBuddyReborn on the next pass. The caught fish stay protected from WahTools' own discard and desynth rules until the run ends, including while a blocked run waits for Resume.
- Both run after GatherBuddyReborn and before Artisan, and crafts that need them wait for them. Each has its own setting under Dispatch behavior, both on by default; with WahTools absent or both settings off, routing is exactly as before. Stop ends a WahTools fish or hunt in progress.
